name: 14-Methoxymetopon
summary: 14-Methoxymetopon is an experimental opioid drug developed by a team led by Professor Helmut Schmidhammer at the University of Innsbruck in the mid-1990s. It is a derivative of metopon in which a methoxy group has been inserted at the 14-position.

pharmacology.text: It binds strongly to the μ-opioid receptor and activates it to a greater extent than most similar opioid drugs.

uses.text: 14-Methoxymetopon is an experimental opioid drug developed by a team led by Professor Helmut Schmidhammer at the University of Innsbruck in the mid-1990s.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Drugs of its class, the opioids, cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and slowed breathing, and an overdose can stop breathing and kill. They also cause dependence, with a hard withdrawal. Very strong opioids like this make overdose much more likely.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。同類的鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便祕與呼吸變慢，過量可能使呼吸停止而致命。這類藥物也會造成依賴，戒斷過程辛苦。像這樣極強效的鴉片類藥物更容易導致過量。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。同类的鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与呼吸变慢，过量可能使呼吸停止而致命。这类药物也会造成依赖，戒断过程辛苦。像这样极强效的鸦片类药物更容易导致过量。

fact.en: It came out of a long series of 14-alkoxy morphinans made by Helmut Schmidhammer's team at the University of Innsbruck in Austria.
fact.zh: 它出自奧地利因斯布魯克大學Helmut Schmidhammer團隊所製造的一系列14-烷氧基嗎啡喃化合物。
fact.zhHans: 它出自奥地利因斯布鲁克大学Helmut Schmidhammer团队所制造的一系列14-烷氧基吗啡喃化合物。
